# Embassy v1.9.5 — the wire keeps its secrets

The first reverse federation dial found the leak: brokers exported private `lease_*` registration IDs as peer-catalog refs, and the strict `reg_*` wire contract rightly refused them — so any broker with v2-migrated state couldn't answer `initialize` (fresh installs slipped through only because their random IDs happened to be `reg_`-shaped). Route authority now crosses the wire as an opaque, deterministic, host-bound hash — same shape everywhere, nothing private in it — proven symmetric across catalog export, consent edges, and handoff admission by a live two-broker round trip.

Upgrade: `npm install -g agent-embassy@1.9.5`, restart your brokers, and re-run `embassy pair` once for cross-host edges your broker owns (mirrors rebuild themselves within 30 seconds).
